name: @nonnajs/di
description: Nonna DI - A flat, zero-reflection, AOT-driven dependency injection container for TypeScript and JavaScript. Completely agnostic across Node.js, Bun, and Deno.
author: Manuel Santos <ney.br.santos@gmail.com>

scripts.test:coverage: node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/**/*.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='src/**/*.test.ts' --test-coverage-exclude='src/**/*.spec.ts' --test --test-reporter node-test-reporter --test-reporter-destination stdout --test-reporter lcov --test-reporter-destination coverage/lcov.info --test-reporter junit --test-reporter-destination coverage/junit.xml --require ts-node/register test/**/*.{test,it.test}.ts
